projects.name: Cotsi
projects.subtitle: **Co**mplex-**t**o-**Si**mple
projects.tagline: Upload your CV. Learn *only what you're missing.*
projects.description: Cotsi reads your CV, finds the roles rising in your field over the next 3–6 months, and builds a syllabus of only the skills you're missing, sized to the hours you have. Then it teaches each one in short lessons and helps you find openings where you stand out.

highlights.title: Starts from your CV
highlights.text: Cotsi reads what you already know, so you never sit through lessons on skills you already have.

highlights.title: Aimed at roles that are rising
highlights.text: It checks hiring, funding and new tools for roles likely to grow in your field, with the evidence linked. Forecasts, not job guarantees.

highlights.title: Learned so it sticks
highlights.text: The few ideas that matter most come first, played out as scenes with characters you like, with a quick check after each one.

demo.title: Why can't anyone read your password on public Wi-Fi?
demo.note: In Cotsi, these lines come from characters in the show you pick.

lines.text: Easy. I lock my message in a box and mail the key separately.
Someone opens every envelope. They'd get the box and the key. So instead, the bank mails you an open padlock. Anyone can snap it shut. Only the bank can open it.
Unless someone swaps the padlock on the way.
Exactly why websites need certificates. That's lesson two.

projects.success: You're on the Cotsi list. I'll message you the moment early access opens.
